site: Unnamed Seamount 04 - Northwest of Holanikū (Kure Atoll)
expedition: Beyond the Blue: Papahanaumokuakea ROV and Mapping
purpose: The goal of EX2503 Dive 11 was to explore the western ridge arm of an unnamed seamount northwest of Hōlanikū (Kure Atoll), in northwestern Papahānaumokuākea. As the shallowest dive of the expedition (summit at only 370 meters), this seamount represented a very different community than those seen previously. We expected to see a high number of mesopelagic fish and anticipated that the seamount may intersect with the daytime descent of the deep scattering layer.
